WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_major,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_count) as total FROM group_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_major,
    group_count,
    CAST(group_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share
  FROM group_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    group_count,
    share,
    (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as avg_share,
    share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as excess
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(group_count) as total_members_above_avg,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_avg_share
FROM above_avg
